summary:
No autonomous diligence ships on main 15e78e276. The pieces exist but are not connected, and a user cannot flag a concept, open question or key insight and have it researched autonomously.

The continuous-research daemon behind antiek-continuous-research.service is deployed and enabled (deploy.yml:279-290), but it can never spawn. Its production entry point calls run_forever(config=config) with the default spawn_fn=no_op_spawn (daemon.py:52-55, 283, 325-334). I ran one iteration on two synthetic investigations that shared a gap. It observed the gap, attempted one spawn and recorded skipped_reasons={'spawn_declined': 1}. Several places still describe the daemon as spawning: operator_gate_actions.md:454-456, the SuggestedResearch header (SuggestedResearch.tsx:14-15) and html-projection SPR-07.

The daemon's inputs are evidentiary_gaps that the model emits. It never reads user flags. FloatMenu has Note, Dialogue, Search and Deep-research, and no Flag or Watch action (FloatMenu.tsx:194-203). The Note action writes marginalia.noted, which the daemon ignores. Parked questions (/watch-for-later, BrainstormStation, ⌘K) come only from automatic question.identified emitters: the note-taker and a heuristic over reader voice notes. They launch only when the user clicks.

What is wired:
- A read-only "Suggested next" lane (GET /research/suggestions), with one explicit "Chase this" through the capped launch path.
- Manual parked-question launch.
- A per-browser unread badge in NavRail.

What is built but unreachable:
- Per-investigation autonomous chase (chase_mode). POST /investigations does not expose it.
- The Deep Research Bridge insight/open-question extractor and gap-finder. They have zero callers and zero tests.
- Monitoring mode. It is CLI-only.
- The artifact-comment to agent_work to reply-in-thread path. It is compiled off in the shipped bundle (RUN).

What exists only in specs: the whole never-sleeping agent (D3: live spawn, standing topics, re-ingestion scheduler, living-folder refresh, learning digest), the attention inbox and the Midnight Oil runner. Midnight Oil ships a preflight only.

Budget controls are env-only. The systemd unit sets ANTIEK_DAEMON_BUDGET_USD_PER_DAY, which no Python reads; the code reads ANTIEK_DAEMON_HOURLY_BUDGET_USD. Settings shows the daemon cap read-only. There is no opt-in, pause or per-flag approval.

CRAFT: I re-checked the 2026-09-23 baseline (24/48 = 50%, two vetoes) on main 15e78e276, and every cited blocker is still present:
- the PanelLayout hooks crash across 768px;
- BrainPresence overflow;
- MascotStation fixed z-[60] over content;
- the stone-50 body with darkMode "media";
- no focus-visible ring on LemonButton, and disabled buttons drop pointer events;
- outline-none on the FloatMenu textareas.

Mothership-specific gaps:
- FloatMenu (the island) appears with no motion. It has no roving focus and does not return focus on Esc. Its position is clamped with a hardcoded 44px height, so an expanded panel can leave the viewport.
- The floating ChaseThread panel's exit animation never runs, because nothing wraps it in AnimatePresence.
- Floating panels are not rendered below 768px, so highlight-to-chase has no phone path. This is still true on w3.
- ReadingCompanion is hidden below 1024px, with no way to open it.
- The empty state of the Suggested lane falsely says the model provider isn't configured, which is a veto-class honesty defect.
- FloatMenu, SuggestedResearch, ReadingCompanion, ChaseThread and MyResearch have no stories or visual baselines.

None of the four design branches (w1, w3, w5, w7) has been merged, and none has a PR. Each merges cleanly onto main alone (git merge-tree), but w3 conflicts with both w5 and w7 in PanelLayout.tsx. w3 already contains all of w1.

capabilities.name: Flag a concept from a document, highlight or thread

evidence.note: The menu actions are Note, Dialogue, Search and Deep-research, plus Rewrite, Make stronger, Spin a sub-agent and Edit on Write only. There is no Flag, Watch or Pin action.

The only related ActionTypes are note.emerged/refined, question.identified/escalated/resolved and marginalia.noted. Nothing like concept.flagged exists. The two *.flagged types (decomposer.paraphrase.flagged, graph.staleness.flagged) are system signals.

evidence.note: 0 files

risks: Docs overstate the daemon. operator_gate_actions.md:454-456, the SuggestedResearch.tsx:14-15 header ('within its §7.4 caps chases the best') and html-projection SPR-07 all describe a spawning daemon, but it has never spawned (no_op_spawn; RUN probe spawn_declined). A spec built on 'the daemon already runs diligence' would be wrong from the start.

Budget config drift. The unit sets ANTIEK_DAEMON_BUDGET_USD_PER_DAY, but the code reads ANTIEK_DAEMON_HOURLY_BUDGET_USD (budget.py:36; j2:54-56). The moment spawn is wired, an operator who edits the unit's cap changes nothing, and only the hardcoded $5 default applies.

There is no owner scope. scan_gaps enumerates every events file regardless of owner (daemon.py:90-102,127), and so do /watch-for-later (app.py:5035-5057) and /research/suggestions. main's tip just merged the owner-namespace work (#3382), so wiring spawn before D3 SPR-01 owner lineage risks cross-owner leaks and spend.

Decay and depth caps reset on restart. Chase counts and research topics live only in memory (daemon.py:70-85; research_topic.py:16-19), so after each Restart=on-failure the §7.4 decay rule starts over, and a wired daemon could re-chase the same gaps daily up to the cap.

The spend authority is a JSON sidecar (~/.antiek/budgets/daemon_<date>.json), not the primary-DB BudgetLedger. D3 names that ledger as the sole scheduled-spend authority. Reserve and record run in a non-atomic read-modify-write outside db_lock.

Prompt-injection boundary: html-projection's SPR-07 rationale assumes the daemon opens documents autonomously. Once spawn is wired, autonomous runs will read untrusted corpus text, and that ingestion boundary becomes live.

The artifact-comment to agent_work path depends on an external bridge consumer (infrastructure/connectors/herdr_bridge). It is compiled off in prod (RUN bundle), and its runtime health is NOT MEASURED here.
